text:
leo_cs: Heads up: onboarding pilot (tenant: ember-co) seeing mixed 429+401 during SDK warmup on mobile web. Customer says issue only shows behind HTTP/2 proxy.
mira_infra: ops-bot flagged many concurrent preflight calls from same IP but different streams.
ops-bot: Alert: http2_multiplex_preflight_spike tenant=ember-co concurrent_streams=12 :warning:
sophia_se: Any traces? we need root cause before offering quota bump.
leo_cs: customer shared short trace + header dump. Redacted: 
```
[2026-03-20T09:12:05Z] client: open h2 conn stream=1 preflight /v1/prefetch
[2026-03-20T09:12:05Z] client: stream=2 preflight /v1/prefetch
[2026-03-20T09:12:05Z] token: issued ephemeral ttl=10s id=eyJ..A
[2026-03-20T09:12:05Z] client: stream=2 saw token expired (race) and requested refresh -> new token id=eyJ..B
[2026-03-20T09:12:05Z] gateway: received both headers on different streams, validated separately -> counted as two preflights
[2026-03-20T09:12:05Z] gateway: quota hit 429 tenant=ember-co
```
leo_cs: header dump shows the same connection sent different Authorization headers on concurrent streams and a custom header `x-emb-token` used by their wrapper.
dave_sdk: sounds like two problems: (A) ephemeral TTL very short (10s) + no in-process singleflight across streams, (B) proxy-level connection pooling means multiple workers reuse same TCP conn with different threads causing duplicate preflight.
sophia_se: what's SDK quick-fix surface? can we add per-connection singleflight keyed by connection id?
dave_sdk: Node/browser SDK can't see h2 connection id reliably. Quick wins: (1) Extend default ephemeral TTL suggestion in docs from 10s -> 60s for mobile web preflight, (2) SDK add in-memory singleflight by token-hash for 1s window to collapse concurrent refreshes, (3) Expose configuration to prefer `Authorization` header if `x-emb-token` present, and log duplicates. I'll prototype a PR for (2).
mira_infra: infra side: we can add gateway rule to treat concurrent streams from same source IP + same TLS session ID as single preflight for quota calc (best-effort). That reduces double-counting but is risky. Need RFC and short rollback plan.
leo_cs: Customer is on a timed pilot. Recommend we: (a) apply temporary tenant quota adjustment (streams preflight limit 8->30 for 12h), (b) push SDK patch to canary (singleflight collapse + 200ms backoff), (c) add docs note about TTL and proxies. I'll coordinate customer comms.
ops-bot: Note: quota overrides will be audited and emit billing events.
sophia_se: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/sdk/pulls/825 contains singleflight map + 200ms exponential jitter. Backport to 1.x?
dave_sdk: yes will backport. Adding opt-in flag `collapseTokenRefresh=true` so current customers can opt in.
mira_infra: created infra ticket INF-7489 for temporary quota bump and gateway best-effort aggregation experiment. Tagging gateway-team.
leo_cs: filed onboarding ticket ONB-9901 and included patched SDK RC, logs, and customer impact matrix.
sophia_se: also adding a server-side response header prototype `X-Prefer-Token: Authorization` and `X-Refresh-Suggest: 60s` to help clients detect collisions. Opens RFC with gateway team.
mira_infra: ack. Will hold quota change until CS confirms.
leo_cs: I'll request approval now and send customer a short mitigations checklist: 1) upgrade to SDK RC (canary) 2) increase ephemeral TTL to >=60s 3) avoid double token headers 4) watch preflight metric for 6 hours.
sophia_se: once canary proves stable we'll cut RC and backport. Please capture post-mortem notes for onboarding playbook.
leo_cs: will do. Closing when metrics stable or after 12h window. Thanks all!
